Streaming chat completion with tool/function call chunks

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using System.Text.Json;
using LiterLlm;

var ConfigOptions = new JsonSerializerOptions { PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true };
var apiKey = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("API_KEY") ??
  throw new InvalidOperationException("API_KEY must be set");
  using var client = LiterLlmConverter.CreateClient(apiKey, null, null, null, null);
await foreach (var chunk in client.ChatStreamAsync(new ChatCompletionRequest { Messages = new List<Message>() { JsonSerializer.Deserialize<Message>("{\"content\":\"What's the weather?\",\"role\":\"user\"}", ConfigOptions)! }, Model = "gpt-4", Tools = new List<ChatCompletionTool>() { JsonSerializer.Deserialize<ChatCompletionTool>("{\"function\":{\"name\":\"get_weather\",\"parameters\":{\"properties\":{\"city\":{\"type\":\"string\"}},\"type\":\"object\"}},\"type\":\"function\"}", ConfigOptions)! } }))
  {
      Console.WriteLine(chunk);
  }
```
